title: 'For Azerbaijan, peace with Armenia is achieved,' President Ilham Aliyev says
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev declared that "peace is achieved" with Armenia following an August White House summit. "For me, it is done," he said.
